The register needs a local server

Opening index.html directly will not work: browsers refuse to run ES modules or read data/*.json from a file:// address. Nothing is wrong with the build.

On a Mac — double-click Open POS.command in this folder.

Anywhere — from this folder, run:

python3 -m http.server 8080

then open http://localhost:8080. Once it has loaded once, it works offline. Manager PIN is 1234.
